chart.title: Death rate
chart.subtitle: Annual number of deaths per 1,000 people in the total population.
chart.note: Estimates may be uncertain for countries with poor vital registration systems.

Death rate - Sex: all - Age: all - Varia.descriptionShort: The number of deaths in a year per 1,000 people in the population.
descriptionKey: This is a *crude* death rate — it is not adjusted for differences in age structure between countries. Even when two countries have similar mortality at each age, the country with an older population will report a higher crude death rate.
